structured_output.what_is_happening: A "Katy Perry" celebrity-name token launched directly on PumpSwap (created and migrated in the same second), with metadata pointing at Katy Perry's official X handle and website but no real project link. Within about 13 minutes it spiked to a GMGN ATH price of ~0.00109, roughly $1.08M market cap, then fell about 90% in the last 5 minutes to ~$88k. That crash window carried more than half of all volume: $46k of $86k, with 2,800 transactions. Top10 excluding the pool is only 2.5%, so the large early holders have already sold. GMGN puts the top entrapment-trader share at 77.7% and rat/insider traders at 13%. LP is 100% burned, mint and freeze are renounced, and RugCheck shows no risks. A near-dead copycat with the same name exists at $0 liquidity.

narrative.description: Celebrity-name meme (Katy Perry) with a joke description and borrowed official links. There is no evidence of a real endorsement or a news catalyst in the packet.
narrative.why_spreading: Celebrity names draw fast speculative flow on pump.fun, possibly tied to some Katy Perry news that I can't check. The run to ~$1M followed by a -90% candle points to an insider/trap pump that has already been distributed, not a story that is still spreading.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the one active pair with real liquidity, and it launched about 3 minutes before the copycat. But nothing ties it to Katy Perry: the linked X account and website are the celebrity's own, used without permission.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6mQq... 'KATY PERRY' has $0 liquidity and is effectively dead. More celebrity-name clones are likely if there is real news.

authenticity.evidence: 2,321 unique buyers and 3,000+ holders show real breadth. Against that: the 77.7% entrapment-trader share, 329 rat-trader wallets, a dev X account linked to 200 launched tokens, a direct PumpSwap launch with a same-second migration, and a 20x spike then -90% crash within minutes all fit a manufactured trap pump. No paid boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't tell whether a real Katy Perry news event drove organic retail flow, or whether this was a coordinated pump-and-dump.

structural_risks: Price already down ~90% from its ~$1.08M peak; holders sitting on losses will sell into any bounce
The entrapment-trader flag is very high (77.7%)
Dev X account is tied to 200 launched tokens (serial launcher)
Celebrity-impersonation links; risk of delisting or takedown
$25k liquidity against thin, fading demand after the dump

structured_output.counterargument: The dump may have cleared out the insiders. Holders are now very spread out (top10 at 2.5%), LP is burned so it can't be pulled, and 2,300+ unique buyers show real interest in the name. After a 90% capitulation, a dead-cat bounce from $88k back to $176k (only about 16% of the ATH) is a common pattern, especially if there is real Katy Perry news. Dip buyers who saw $1M could easily push it up 2x.
unknowns: Whether there is real Katy Perry news driving the flow
Price action in the 4 minutes before entry (still falling or bouncing)
Who dumped from the ATH and whether they are fully out
Whether the ATH was a real trade or a single outlier wick

structured_output.thesis: A post-dump celebrity-name coin. It already did its roughly 20x and crashed 90% within its first 13 minutes, with strong trap/insider signals and a serial-launcher dev X account. The burned LP keeps the rug risk moderate, but getting back to 2x from here needs a fresh catalyst. The most likely path is a weak bounce followed by bleeding out.
